verdict.line: You lose if you eat a fully-charged Q and trade into an Enrage-boosted Sion sitting behind his shield; you win if you dodge the stun and punish the 8-12 second window his kit is dead on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Sion's entire kill threat is one single-target stun — Q (Cryptic Gaze), 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown — that has to be aimed and held before it fires. Whiff it or bait it onto cooldown and he's left with autos that cost him his own health through E (Enrage). Mundo turns every one of those trades into compounding value: W (Burning Agony) shortens any stun he does land while chipping Sion's health, and Q (Infected Cleaver) hits for max-health damage, which only gets juicier as Sion's E passively inflates his own HP pool over the game.

theirWindow.when: Q (Cryptic Gaze) lands clean on you
theirWindow.what: He'll chain autos with E (Enrage) toggled on while you're locked down, so juke or bodyblock the aim phase so this combo never starts.

yourWindow.when: right after his Q whiffs or hits cooldown
yourWindow.what: Walk up and trade freely — land Q (Infected Cleaver) and stack W (Burning Agony) for up to 12 seconds since he has no stun to punish you with.

powerCurve.note: Both weak; single Q stun is his only tool

start.why: Sustains through Sion's auto-attack pokes and the passive regen stacks with Adrenaline Rush, letting you shrug off chip damage while you wait out his Q cooldown.

boots.why: The extra move speed is purely for repositioning during his Q charge-up and closing distance once it's spent — you don't need tenacity against a kit with only one disable.

core.why: Snowballs raw max health from takedowns, which directly feeds Q's percent-max-health damage and gives you the bulk to absorb Enrage-boosted autos.
A massive health pool paired with the regen amp lets you spam W (Burning Agony) longer and recover faster between trades than Sion can punish.
Adds cleave and bonus max-health scaling damage, which matters more as Sion's E permanently inflates his own HP pool over the game.

situational.when: the enemy team adds magic damage threats or you need more healing power from your passive and W
sion rushes attack speed and leans on cannibalism's steroid in extended fights
you need more raw damage output while staying tanky in prolonged skirmishes

runes.keystoneWhy: Triggers on autos whenever you trade with Sion, converting those exchanges into permanent max-health growth that directly scales up Q's cleaver damage for the rest of the lane.

summoners.why: Teleport lets your health-stacking build scale into side-lane pressure and return to objectives, while Ghost closes the gap the instant his Q is spent so you can convert your solo-kill advantage.

playing.title: Dodge the charge-up
playing.detail: Q (Cryptic Gaze) has a visible aim/charge before it fires — walk unpredictably near brush edges and juke sideways the moment he raises his stare instead of standing still.

playing.title: Trade the instant Q lands
playing.detail: Once Q connects it's on cooldown for up to 12 seconds at rank one — immediately engage with Q (Infected Cleaver) and stack W (Burning Agony) since he has nothing to threaten you with.

playing.title: All-in when low on health
playing.detail: E (Masochism) grants AD based on your missing health, so trading down and leaning on your passive regen to recover turns you into the bigger threat in extended fights.

playing.title: Don't dump damage into his shield
playing.detail: W (Death's Caress) absorbs damage until it explodes or he detonates it early — hold your burst until the shield pops instead of wasting hits on it.

playing.title: Pre-toggle W before eating a stun
playing.detail: Burning Agony reduces the duration of disables while draining your own health for continual damage, so turn it on before trading so any Q that does land locks you down for less time.

playing.title: Respect brush before committing
playing.detail: Sion can hide in brush to land a fully-charged Q unexpectedly — ward or clear brush near his side before facechecking or overextending to farm.

playing.title: Race his self-damage, don't panic
playing.detail: E (Enrage) costs Sion his own health per auto to boost his AD — trade through it rather than backing off, since his damage spike is bleeding his HP just as much as yours.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are measured OP.GG data from current patch games; the cooldown windows and trade-pattern reasoning above are this brief's own tactical read.
